newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-PRIVALOVA MAY MISS ENTIRE SEASON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PRIVALOVA MAY MISS ENTIRE SEASON.

text.p: Russian sprint star Irina Privalova could miss the entire season because of a thigh injury sustained at the World Indoor Championships in Paris last March, her coach said on Thursday.
Privalova will have a cast removed on Monday, but her coach and husband Vladimir Parashchyuk said the injury seemed much more serious than during an initial check-up and she could be out all summer.
The three times indoor world champion, who suffered the injury in the 60 metres indoor final, underwent surgery at Moscow's Burdenko military hospital on April 18 to repair the torn muscle.
Meanwhile, double Olympic champion Svetlana Masterkova said she will run only the 800 metres at the European Champion Clubs Cup meeting in Valencia, Spain, this weekend.
Masterkova, the Olympic 800 and 1,500 metres champion, has been running well in training but said she was targetting her year towards the World Championships in August.
